capabilities: Create a note for each block in an Are.na channel
Push the open note's content to an Are.na channel or block
Create notes from single blocks by ID or URL
Download block attachments to configurable folders
Open the selected block on the Are.na website
extras: Attachment downloads are off by default and must be enabled in settings; the roadmap lists unfinished items like a template system.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to exchange content with Are.na, so blocks saved there can't be read or edited from the vault.

relations.evidence: Publish content from your vault to Are.na and the other way around.

requires.name: Are.na Personal Access Token with read and write access

summary: Two-way connector that pulls Are.na channel blocks into notes and pushes vault notes back to Are.na channels or blocks.
